  `order_id` varchar(65533) NOT NULL COMMENT "",

  `season` varchar(65533) NOT NULL COMMENT "",
  `month` int(11) NOT NULL COMMENT "",
  `region` varchar(65533) NOT NULL COMMENT "",
  `quantity` int(11) NOT NULL COMMENT "",
  `sales_amount` double NOT NULL COMMENT "",
  `discount_percentage` int(11) NOT NULL COMMENT "",
  `product_id` varchar(65533) NOT NULL COMMENT ""
) ENGINE=OLAP
